facts: Dangerous Footing: a natural 1 on an Agility test also inflicts a Str -, AP -, L1 hit that automatically Wounds with no saves.

Face Off: the winner of a roll-off picks a battlefield edge and their opponent takes the opposite one. Each gang deploys between its own edge and a line 9" from the centre line. On a 2' table that is a 3" strip along each edge, 18" apart.

King of the Hive: one objective sits at the centre of the battlefield. In the Check for Victory step of each End phase it scores 1 VP for the gang controlling it, and the first gang to 3 VP wins. If only one gang still has models on the battlefield, they win; if neither does, it is a draw.
{p:Crippling Strike:} if, in the Check for Victory step of any End phase, at least half of the enemy models on the battlefield are Seriously Injured or Engaged, the side job is done.

{t:Stitch 'Em Up!:} when a fighter makes a Coup de Grâce action against a Seriously Injured enemy, they may plant evidence on them instead of taking them Out of Action. If at least one enemy fighter has evidence planted on them by the end of the battle, the side job is done.
Escalating Engagement: both gangs use Hybrid (3+D3) for their starting crew, then bring on Reinforcements (5), D3 each round from the first.
